comments.name: scottisafool
comments.content: An alternative is to have two fields on your page/control for the two different interfaces/objects and bind to whichever is relevant. For example https://github.com/MediaBrowser/Emby.Mobile.Universal/blob/Dev/Emby.Mobile.Universal/Controls/ItemControls/UserDtoControl.xaml.cs#L9-L10

comments.name: Barry Manilowa
comments.content:
Window Template Studio using MVVM Light allows you to x:Bind to ViewModel which is provided by its Locator service.  It allows you to do the following:

Text="{x:Bind ViewModel.MyText }"

The syntax is a bit wordy, but get's the job done.
